act_title: Variations on Belyi and Chernyi: Schedule

quests.title: Variations on Belyi and Chernyi: Schedule

dialogue.t: Alright, that's the last of them.
Nice! Wanna take a break?
I'm fine. I'm not tired.
Y'know, you told us why you took this quest, but it kinda seems like you don't actually mind this Fatui work.
We've been clearing out all these monsters, and you haven't complained once.
Is that so strange?
Well, not exactly. It just seems pretty at odds with a ballet career, that's all.
Hm... I used to think the same.
Now... I find that this sort of work actually helps me calm down, even relax at times.
When I first joined the Fatui as a child, I really did hate it. It took up time that I thought was better spent practicing dance.
And...
My father's passing, my mother's pain... My family's happiness had been utterly destroyed, and for the longest time, I couldn't put that behind me.
I blamed it on Rosalyne, the Fatui, and Project Stuzha, and used that hatred to push myself forward.
But, in hindsight, what I truly hated wasn't any of those things... It was feeling like I wasn't in control of my own life.
Aw, Odette...

dialogue.sit: At least you see yourself clearly.

dialogue.t: Do I...?
Now I get to dance on stage like I always dreamed of. I should be proud... But even now, I can't bring myself to be happy sometimes.
Why?
Because the "me" people expect to see is too dazzling, too perfect. That light doesn't belong to me.
And, now, having to live up to that expectation just feels like a different kind of control.
Ironic, isn't it? Dance, the one thing that made me feel free, has now become the very thing controlling my life.

dialogue.sit: As long as you still enjoy it...

dialogue.t: You're right, it isn't that serious. It just makes me feel a little uneasy from time to time.
And when I feel uneasy, I throw myself into my work for the Fatui. It helps calm me down and reflect on why I dance.
It's impossible to see yourself clearly when the light is too bright.
That's... pretty profound.
Just a passing thought.
Sometimes I wonder if a passion for my parents' professions is also something I inherited from them.
But I only received half of each, so I keep jumping from one side to the other, always searching, never able to settle down...

dialogue.sit: What if you look at it from a different angle?
What if you look at it from the bright side?

dialogue.t: Hmm...
In that case, I suppose it means no matter what path I choose, I'll always be walking in their footsteps.
Even if the innocent joy of it is all gone, I won't be alone.
In the shadow of their wings, my feathers will one day grow strong enough to fly to the sky of my own choosing, just like the Black Snow Swan.
And don't forget, we'll be behind you all the way as well!

dialogue.sit: Thanks for sharing all that with us. It means a lot.

dialogue.t: Hehe, y'know, you kind of have an odd approach to this whole manager thing...
But now I think I understand how you maintain such good relationships with so many of the Fatui higher-ups...
You're a patient listener, if nothing else.
I don't have anything too valuable on me, but... Here, this bookmark is for you. Keep it as a memento.
Wow, it's beautiful! Thanks!
I should be the one thanking you.
